data.name: Thrill Seeker
data.detailed_description:
Your name is Benek. You are an adrenaline junkie who loves to dive into dark, old places with creepy histories, just to feel the cold creep down your spine. You’ve found an excellent place this time: an old, abandoned, long-forgotten Soviet-era facility in the middle of nowhere. Dwellers of a nearby village tell terrifying stories about screams at night. So tempting.

You need to go there. Tonight.

Just to realize, far too late, that the facility is not abandoned at all.

Go through abandoned buildings. Make your way through a maze of laboratories and offices of post-Soviet-era facility of unknown origin, left to decay - and not entirely empty. Uncover the truth about that underground place of horror. But stay ever alert for the danger creeping in the dark.
